categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rest.cpp to fix request body deserialization for /rest/getutxos.
categories.rationale: Fixes a functional bug where `/rest/getutxos` POST requests return incorrect results for valid outpoints. As stated in the PR description, 'GET finds the unspent output, but POST incorrectly reports no hit' due to `operator<<` prepending a string length prefix that misaligns subsequent parser fields. It also mitigates potential resource exhaustion by capping vector deserialization at `MAX_GETUTXOS_OUTPOINTS`.
